title: Paste the HTML your AI wrote. Get a link your client can open.
excerpt: An .html attachment won't open on a phone and a PDF flattens the charts. SendPage turns the document into a link that opens in one tap — and still exports to PDF, image or Word with the design intact.
content_html:
For everyone who makes documents with AI

Your AI made a beautiful document.
Deliver it beautifully.

An .html attachment looks unprofessional, and printing to PDF flattens the charts. SendPage turns your document into a link your client opens in one tap — exports it to PDF, image or Word when they want a file, and lets you fix a typo without sending a new link.

No signup · 5 free documents a month · Works in WhatsApp, WeChat and email

Paste it here. Get your link.

The whole thing takes about thirty seconds, and you keep the link forever.

How it appears in WhatsApp

Here's the document 👆

No signup needed · 5 free documents a month

Why SendPage?

Everyone has an AI that writes a beautiful document in seconds. What it hands you is a file full of HTML — and there is no good way to send that to a client. Attached to an email it looks suspicious and will not open properly on a phone. Printing it to PDF flattens the charts and cuts the wide tables in half. A screenshot throws away the text. So the document that looked professional on your screen arrives looking like homework — and you end up apologising for it before your client has read a word.

  • Paste HTML, get a link
  • Exports to PDF, image and Word
  • Edit the text after you have sent it

Everything the link needs to look like your work

Convert to PDF, image or Word

We render your page in a real browser and capture that, so the design survives. PDF for printing, a long image for chat, Word when a client wants to edit it. Wide diagrams turn the page instead of losing a column.

Click any text in the document and type — no code needed — or paste a fresh version your AI regenerated. The link never changes, and the PDF rebuilds itself.

Arrives as a card, not a URL

WhatsApp, WeChat and email show your title, your name and a thumbnail of the real document.

Simple pricing

No signup needed — you're signed in straight after paying. Cancel any time; documents you made while subscribed stay unlocked forever. Just need one document? $1.

Questions

What exactly does SendPage do?

It hosts the HTML document your AI generated and gives you a link to send. Your customer taps the link and reads the document — no download, no app, no account.

Will my design survive?

In the browser, yes — it is your document, running as written. For PDF and image exports we render the real page in a real browser and capture that, so what you see is what you get. Word export is best-effort: text and structure carry over, complex layouts may shift.

Can I fix a typo after I've sent the link?

Yes, and the link never changes. Open your private manage link, click Edit content, then click any text on the page and type — no code needed. You can also paste a fresh version of the HTML if you regenerated it with your AI. Downloads and the chat preview update themselves.

Does Chinese, Japanese or Korean text work?

Yes. The viewer and every export ship with CJK fonts, so Chinese documents export to PDF with all characters intact.

Who can see my document?

Anyone with the link. Links are random and unlisted, so they are not guessable and not indexed — but treat them like a shared file. For anything sensitive, upgrade the document and set a password.

Do I need an account?

Not to create or send anything. If you subscribe, you are signed in straight after payment and given a private link to save — that link gets you back in on any device, and you can also sign in with your email.

What does it cost?

Free for 5 documents a month, with a small SendPage footer. Pro is $5 a month (or $40 a year) for unlimited documents with no footer, Word export and password protection. You can also unlock a single document for $1.

What happens if I cancel?

Every document you made while subscribed stays unlocked forever — a link already sitting in a client’s chat never changes. Only new documents go back to the free plan.

How big can a document be?

Up to 2 MB of HTML. That is a large document — if you are over, the usual cause is images pasted inline as data URLs; link or compress them.

问题

What exactly does SendPage do?

它托管您的 AI 生成的 HTML 文档，并为您提供要发送的链接。 您的客户点击链接并阅读文档 - 无需下载，无需应用程序，无需帐户。

Will my design survive?

在浏览器中，是的 - 这是您的文档，按编写的方式运行。 对于 PDF 和图像导出，我们在真实浏览器中渲染真实页面并捕获该页面，因此所见即所得。 Word 导出是尽力而为：文本和结构会保留，复杂的布局可能会发生变化。

Can I fix a typo after I've sent the link?

是的，并且链接永远不会改变。 打开您的私人管理链接，单击编辑内容，然后单击页面上的任何文本并键入 - 无需代码。 如果您使用 AI 重新生成了 HTML，您还可以粘贴新版本的 HTML。 下载和聊天预览会自行更新。

Does Chinese, Japanese or Korean text work?

是的。 查看器和每个导出都带有 CJK 字体，因此中文文档导出为 PDF 时所有字符都完好无损。

Who can see my document?

任何有链接的人。 链接是随机的且未列出，因此它们不可猜测且未编入索引 - 但请将它们视为共享文件。 对于任何敏感内容，请升级文档并设置密码。

Do I need an account?

不创建或发送任何东西。 如果您订阅，您将在付款后直接登录，并获得一个要保存的私人链接 - 该链接可让您在任何设备上重新登录，您也可以使用电子邮件登录。

What does it cost?

每月免费 5 个文档，带有一个小的 SendPage 页脚。 Pro 版每月 5 美元（或每年 40 美元），可获取无限文档，无页脚、Word 导出和密码保护。 您还可以花费 1 美元解锁单个文档。

What happens if I cancel?

您在订阅期间制作的每个文档都将永远保持解锁状态 - 已经存在于客户聊天中的链接永远不会改变。 只有新文档才会返回免费计划。

How big can a document be?

最多 2 MB 的 HTML。 这是一个很大的文档 — 如果您已经结束，通常的原因是图像作为数据 URL 内嵌粘贴；链接或压缩它们。
